channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Solid deal flow this period: CSL Plasma's $30M plasma-center expansion, Laser Light's $75M investment with a new PR headquarters, Envocore's $129M PRASA water-infrastructure contract, the Army Corps' $1.1B Ferrovial channel contract (Puerto Rico's largest-ever civil works award), and continued retail/hospitality momentum (Marriott's $38M Isla Verde makeover, Five Below and Dunkin' eyeing PR entry, TJ Maxx and Zimmermann openings). Fiscal fundamentals were positive, with FY2026 General Fund revenue up $279M and beating Oversight Board projections on manufacturing-driven corporate tax strength.
